specification.title: Surface · Variable Blend Surfaces — menu binding
specification.goal: Bind menu/commandline for documented Surface Tools command “Variable Blend Surfaces”; reuse owning geometry service rather than reimplement its algorithm
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Surface menu, Sweep/Loft/Trim settings theo Matrix
specification.parent_exclusions: Toán học surface dùng Rhino5 / OCCT.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Surface · Variable Blend Surfaces — menu binding” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Surface · Variable Blend Surfaces — menu binding”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Matrix menu item chỉ dispatch qua qymcad/src/command_catalog.rs / command bus; không tạo một kernel thao tác song song.
Dùng cùng command descriptor, typed options và selection giữa menu, command line và toolbar; kiểm tra disable state khi backend vắng mặt.
Nếu không có owner L3 xác minh được, trạng thái BLOCKED_OWNER, không coi một menu item render thành PASS.
Ứng viên owner L3: OM9-L3-02-04-007; phải kiểm chứng API và test trước khi bật menu.

input.command: Surface · Variable Blend Surfaces — menu binding
input.purpose: Bind menu/commandline for documented Surface Tools command “Variable Blend Surfaces”; reuse owning geometry service rather than reimplement its algorithm
input.selection: typed compatible object for Variable Blend Surfaces

positive.setup: Invoke `Variable Blend Surfaces` through both the Matrix menu and command line with the same valid selection; inspect resulting dispatch and geometry.
positive.expected: Menu and command line resolve to one stable command ID; the owner service executes `Variable Blend Surfaces` exactly once, with correct document delta and undo. No local geometry kernel inside UI adapter.

negative.setup: Invoke `Variable Blend Surfaces` with missing selection, invalid parameter or unavailable backend.
negative.expected: User-visible error/disabled reason, no successful no-op, no document mutation; does not pass simply because menu renders.

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: known planar 10×20 mm face with UV domain and one optional compatible adjacent face
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: exact face/surface created or edited and checked by BRep topology/UV validator
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: no typed selection, invalid numerical option, locked layer, missing backend owner → visible refusal, no document change, no fake success
